source.snippet: I am consuming a deployment status endpoint inside a visual workflow runner (e.g., Salesforce Flow, Power Automate, or n8n). The endpoint returns a deeply nested JSON structure representing metadata deployment history. I have defined the root data schema structure inside my environment... [struggling to map nested arrays through visual workflow steps without code]

problem_statement: Salesforce admins and no-code workflow builders regularly hit a wall when REST APIs return deeply nested JSON arrays — visual workflow tools like Salesforce Flow, Power Automate, and n8n lack reliable mechanisms to flatten or traverse nested structures without custom code, blocking automation projects.
target_segment: Salesforce admins, no-code automation consultants, and RevOps teams at mid-market companies integrating external REST APIs via visual workflow tools.
notes: Paid-platform context: poster is working on a client implementation (Salesforce). Consultants bill hourly for exactly this kind of stuck problem. A tool or reusable component that auto-flattens/maps nested JSON for Flow, Power Automate, or n8n could save significant consultant hours. Signal is a single post with no upvotes, so strength is low — would need corroboration from similar posts.
